# How Direct Debits work

A Direct Debit lets a company collect money from your account. You set it up with the
company, which creates a mandate (an instruction) with us.

## When a Direct Debit fails

A collection fails if the mandate was cancelled, if there is not enough money on the
collection date, or if the company closed the account the Direct Debit belongs to.

## Cancelling a Direct Debit

You can cancel a mandate in the app under Payments, Direct Debits. Tell the company too,
because they will not be able to collect any more payments.
